title: When the Letter Wakes
author: Isandro Iversen
blurb: Edmund Vane, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
